scene_after.dominant_activity: Confession of judicial guilt and plan for a seance
scene_after.summary: In a dimly lit study, Judge Mallik hands over his personal diaries to Sushanto, showing red crosses marked beside capital punishment verdicts with question marks beside doubtful ones. Haunted by the moral weight of executions he decreed, he reveals his intention to conduct a planchette seance to communicate with the deceased.
